# Datamining: PTS Patch 56 Season 19 Enclave

![Datamining: PTS Patch 56 Season 19 Enclave](/uploads/415_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update October 26, 2024] More preview images
